ios.desc:
Audiom helps you transform audio into eye-catching visuals perfect for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms. Whether you’re promoting a podcast episode, sharing a voice message, or creating engaging content, Audiom makes your audio stand out.

Record your voice, and Audiom instantly converts it into a dynamic waveform video. Add captions, customize colors, and choose a style that matches your vibe. In seconds, you’ll have a share-ready video that brings your voice to life. Perfect for podcasters, storytellers, creators, and anyone who wants their voice to be seen and heard.

Features:
• Audio to Waveform Video
Turn voice recordings into stunning animated waveforms.

• Automatic Voice Transcription
Convert spoken words into captions to make your message clearer and more engaging.

• Beautiful Customization
Choose from vibrant colors, gradients, and backgrounds.

• Custom Wave Styles
Adjust waveform style, gain, and animation to match your sound.

• Made for Social Media
Create content ready for Instagram, TikTok, and more.

Audiom Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment for Plus subscription will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription will renew automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. https://appersian.app/audiom/termsofuse.html
